triage_rationale: Existing ascii-studio-desktop (Vite + React 19 + Tauri v2) requires: (1) Accent swap from #00ff88/#ff3366 to single #3B82F6 electric blue across all components and CSS variables, (2) Full media pipeline replacing stub camera/video handlers with real getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, drag-and-drop, and photo capture, (3) Tauri capability upgrades from 4 basic permissions to include camera, filesystem, and media permissions. 21+ source files affected across frontend, engine, contracts, Tauri config layers. 3+ new dependencies potentially needed. Full architecture changes: new media state machine, permission schema expansion, CSS variable overhaul.
framework: Vite + React 19 + Tauri v2 (App Shell + Webview)

architectural_patterns.data_fetching: None — client-side rendering; Tauri invoke() for Rust-side IPC only
architectural_patterns.styling_engine: Tailwind CSS v3.4 + CSS custom properties in index.css
architectural_patterns.orm_database: None — not required for ASCII rendering
architectural_patterns.rendering_pipeline: Canvas2D/WebGPU/WebGL2 ASCII rasterizer with tiered fallback (tier1_webgpu → tier2_webgl → tier3_canvas2d)
architectural_patterns.media_pipeline: Currently stubs only — no getUserMedia, no MediaRecorder, no photo capture, no drag-and-drop
architectural_patterns.target_platform: Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) via Tauri v2 webview
